resident_layers: the consecutive first k layers, with the same M-token historical prefix
compute_scope: complete forward of the N suffix tokens, conditioned on M cached history tokens, in one layer
copy_scope: H2D of M historical tokens' K and V for one layer

policies.next_layer: copy layer i may start when compute layer i-1 starts; copy layer 1 may start at time zero
policies.early_prefetch: at time zero start copying layer k+1, then copy all nonresident layers in order as soon as the copy engine is free

assumptions: one compute stream and one ordered H2D stream; constant C and D per layer
C >= 0 and D > 0; C=0 is only an algebraic boundary case
all uncached historical KV exists in host memory and all cached historical KV is valid
sufficient destination HBM and prefetch space; k is initial residence, not a cap on runtime HBM capacity
no overlap interference, request contention, launch/event overhead, or weights transfer
each complete layer starts after its historical KV is ready; sublayer projection overlap is excluded
all N suffix tokens still execute all L layers; historical KV placement does not remove this computation
only this restoration plus forward interval is modeled, not detection, queueing, full TTFT, or workflow completion
independent C/D scenarios are not calibrated timings of Qwen3-8B
